activity.title: Tendon Gliding Exercise
activity.instructions:
1. Start with your hand open and fingers straight.
2. Slowly bend your fingers into a hook position.
3. Make a gentle fist.
4. Straighten your fingers and relax.
5. Repeat without forcing the movement.
